proven: The event erasure factory starts retention independently of analytics and semantic recall; it covers all registered historical policy databases without creating missing files, schemas or legacy attribution
Each SQLite transaction examines at most 128 IDs/source/deadline records and raw-presence booleans without returning transcript/name/context text to Python
Known raw deadlines scrub trigger phrases, names and raw contexts to pre-filtered numeric metrics while retaining valid numeric metadata; its own expiry deletes the whole policy event
Earlier stored raw dates and source capture deadlines are honored; lower metadata configuration caps are saved before expiry, and reading/restarting/config expansion cannot renew them

Actual raw source expiry also governs the SQL read projection before any physical purge, even if a stored text deadline is later; malformed/unattributed source shapes and invalid metadata dates cannot enter event retrieval, statistics, distributions or sequences
Fact-dependency expiry removes its event metadata without an erasure operation, and committed conversation/fact revocations are honored while pending commit fences only deny readers

A controlled failed fact commit leaves the source provisionally denied, executes both independent and standalone physical cleanup, then rolls back; the original valid event survives and source authority returns
Unknown provenance/deadlines roll back the batch and expose only fixed error codes; corrupt and unsupported historical targets do not become false successes or prevent valid independent cleanup
Native cleanup failure preserves expired data and its durable deadlines for retry after restart; no private exception or traceback is retained in the scheduler outcome/status
A locked historical SQLite database does not hold the authority transaction lock or block the other native sweep; saturating the default executor does not starve the dedicated pool
Three large histories receive admission before a continuation monopolizes the two slots; a 257-row history is scrubbed in batches of 128,128,1
A newly earlier accepted write wakes sleeping retention at its real deadline; late harvest uses the original receipt timestamp and cannot renew the wait
Cancelling an observer retains the actual sweep; a 10 ms close-observation timeout keeps the writer lease until native work exits
An independent Python process rejects Torch/Chroma/sentence-transformers/faster-whisper/ONNX imports while analytics/recall-disabled retention scrubs expired text successfully

The source-free CPython 3.13 smoke closes the event logger before moving the clock to 48 h, then verifies independent physical text/context scrubbing while retaining numeric metadata and requiring no conversation tombstone
